confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Mykonos July pricing, not checked against live listings or menus. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderately reliable. Accommodation is the least certain, since July rates vary widely by season, location and booking timing. Cocktail and wine are estimated from the usual relationship to beer in Greek island bars. The FX observation comes from a search-result excerpt that describes the RBA exchange-rates page; I did not open the RBA page directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on high-demand Greek islands in peak summer, such as Santorini, with restaurant and bar prices set somewhat above mainland Athens tourist areas. Hostel and hotel anchors reflect July peak-season rates.
